result.rationale: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, so when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50/50) it reports 2 pages while only one exists; 'next' sets offset via Math.min(offset+limit, user_count)=50 and loads an empty member list. The off-by-one is directly visible in the diff and produces observable broken pagination behavior.
